scope: The Wistaria Tea House in Taipei in July 2014, including the two-story street-side range, attached lower range, Japanese timber wings, courtyard walls and entrance gate.

originalReview.notes: The 2014 street-corner photo shows the two-story wall, wood siding, lower black-tiled canopy, display glazing, courtyard wall and metal gateway.

quallaSearch.notes: The sole exact Qualla photograph matches the native original by 玄史生. Its creator uploaded it as own work and released it under CC0. It depicts the restored tea house street frontage and garden entrance in 2014.
